props.description: Text to reveal.

props.name: duration

items.title: Neon Text
items.description: Neon sign glow built from layered shadows, with an occasional tube flicker.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to render.

props.name: color
props.description: Glow color.

props.name: flicker

props.name: intensity
props.description: How far the glow reaches.

props.description: Text to render.

props.name: amplitude

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed multiplier.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds of delay between one letter and the next.

props.description: What to pull toward the cursor.

props.name: strength

props.name: radius

props.name: ease
props.description: Seconds the spring back takes.

props.name: children
props.description: Card content.

props.name: maxTilt
props.description: Maximum tilt in degrees.

props.name: glare
props.description: Show a glare highlight that follows the cursor.

props.name: scale
props.description: Scale while hovered.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Perspective distance in pixels.

items.title: Shutter Reveal
items.description: Content is uncovered by slanted bars that slide away one after another.

props.name: children
props.description: What to reveal.

props.name: bars
props.description: How many bars cover the content.

props.name: color
props.description: Bar color.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds until the last bar has cleared.

props.name: direction
props.description: Side the bars start clearing from.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Play once on mount, or replay on hover.

items.title: Grid Floor
items.description: Synthwave perspective grid scrolling toward the viewer, with a glowing horizon fade. Pure CSS.

props.name: color
props.description: Line color.

props.name: speed
props.description: Scroll speed multiplier.

props.name: cell
props.description: Grid cell size in pixels.

props.name: horizon

props.name: glow
props.description: Soft glow on the lines and the horizon.

items.title: Film Grain
items.description: Animated film grain overlay built from SVG turbulence, cycling through four pre-rendered frames.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Grain strength.

props.name: size
props.description: Grain scale. Larger values give coarser grain.

props.name: speed
props.description: Frame rate multiplier.

props.name: monochrome
props.description: Gray grain instead of colored.

items.title: VHS Overlay
items.description: Worn tape look: drifting tracking bands, cyan and magenta color bleed, and a tiny vertical jitter.

props.description: How strong the tape damage looks: 1 subtle, 3 heavy.

props.name: bands
props.description: Number of drifting tracking bands.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed multiplier.

items.title: Dot Grid
items.description: A dot-grid background with a soft spotlight that follows the cursor and lights up the dots near it.

props.name: size
props.description: Pixels between dots.

props.name: dotColor
props.description: Color of the resting dots.

props.name: glowColor
props.description: Color of the spotlight and the lit dots.

props.name: radius
props.description: Spotlight radius in pixels.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Spotlight strength from 0 to 1.

items.title: Glow Border
items.description: A card whose border lights up around the cursor, like modern SaaS cards.

props.name: children
props.description: Card content.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the glow.

props.name: radius
props.description: Spread of the glow in pixels.

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Border thickness in pixels.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Corner radius in pixels.

items.title: Ripple Click
items.description: A material-style ripple that spreads from the exact point you click.

props.name: children
props.description: What to wrap, usually a button.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the ripple.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each ripple takes to fade out.

items.title: Fade In View
items.description: Fades and slides its children in when they scroll into view. Directional, with delay and replay.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to reveal.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction the content travels while appearing.

props.name: distance
props.description: Travel distance in pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the transition.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds to wait before the reveal starts.

props.name: once
props.description: Reveal only the first time. Set to false to hide and replay on every pass.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Share of the element (0 to 1) that must be visible to trigger.

items.title: Marquee
items.description: Infinite horizontal scroller for logos, text or cards. Seamless loop with soft edge fade.

props.name: children
props.description: Items to scroll. They are rendered twice for the loop.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed multiplier. 1 is about 60 pixels per second.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction the items travel.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause while the pointer is over the strip.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between items in pixels.

props.name: fade
props.description: Soft fade mask on the left and right edges.

items.title: Aurora
items.description: Soft aurora background of blurred gradient blobs drifting slowly. Pure CSS.

props.name: colors
props.description: Blob colors, cycled across four blobs.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed multiplier.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur radius of the blobs in pixels.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Overall opacity of the aurora.

items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types one or more strings with a blinking cursor, deleting and moving on to the next. Width stays stable.

props.name: words
props.description: Strings to type. With several entries it deletes each one and moves to the next.

props.name: typeSpeed
props.description: Milliseconds per typed character.

props.name: deleteSpeed
props.description: Milliseconds per deleted character.

props.name: pause
props.description: Milliseconds to hold a finished word before deleting it.

props.name: loop
props.description: Keep cycling. When false, stops after the last word is typed.

props.name: cursor
props.description: Cursor character.

items.title: Gradient Text
items.description: Text filled with a gradient that sweeps across it in a seamless loop.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to render.

props.name: colors
props.description: Gradient stops. End with the first color for a seamless loop.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed multiplier.

props.name: angle
props.description: Gradient angle in degrees.

props.name: animate
props.description: Sweep the gradient. When false, shows it static.

items.title: Count Up
items.description: A number that counts up with easing when it scrolls into view, formatted for any locale.

props.name: to
props.description: Final value.

props.name: from
props.description: Starting value.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the count takes.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Fraction digits shown.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text before the number.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text after the number.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale passed to Intl.NumberFormat.

props.name: once
props.description: Count only the first time it enters the viewport. When false, replays every time.

items.title: Dock
items.description: A macOS-style dock whose icons swell smoothly as the cursor passes over them, with a label tooltip on each.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; icon: ReactNode; onClick?: () => void; href?: string }[]
props.description: Dock entries. An item with href renders as a link, otherwise as a button.

props.name: magnification
props.description: Maximum scale of the icon under the cursor.

props.name: distance
props.description: Distance in pixels along the dock over which the magnification fades out.

props.name: size
props.description: Base icon size in pixels.

props.name: position
props.description: Edge the dock sits on. Icons grow away from it and tooltips open on the opposite side.

items.title: Pill Nav
items.description: A horizontal nav with a single pill that glides to the hovered or selected item.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; href?: string }[]
props.description: Tabs. An item with href renders as a link, otherwise as a button.

props.name: active
props.description: Id of the selected item. Pass it to control the selection.

props.name: defaultActive
props.description: Id of the item selected on mount when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes by click or arrow keys.

props.name: followHover
props.description: Slide the pill to the hovered item and back to the selected one on leave.

items.usage: <PillNav items={[{ id: "home", label: "Home" }, { id: "docs", label: "Docs" }]} defaultActive="home" />

items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expandable sections whose panels animate their height with a rotating chevron. Single or multiple open.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; title: string; content: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Sections to render.

props.name: type
props.description: Whether opening a section closes the others.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Ids of sections open on mount. Only the first is used when type is single.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Allow closing the last open section. When false, one section stays open once opened.

items.title: Carousel
items.description: Scroll-snap slider with arrow buttons, dot indicators, keyboard control and optional autoplay.

props.name: children
props.description: Slides. Each child becomes one slide.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Milliseconds between slides. 0 turns autoplay off. Pauses on hover, on focus and while the tab is hidden.

props.name: loop
props.description: Jump back to the first slide after the last one, and to the last one before the first.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between slides in pixels.

props.name: slidesPerView
props.description: How many slides are visible at once. Fractions like 1.2 show a peek of the next slide.

items.title: Stepper
items.description: Multi-step flow with numbered progress, a line that fills as you advance, and sliding step content.

props.name: steps
props.type: { id: string; title: string; content: ReactNode }[]
props.description: The steps, in order. Only the current step's content is rendered.

props.name: initialStep
props.description: Index of the step shown first.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Called with the new index whenever the step changes.

props.name: onFinish
props.description: Called when the user presses the finish button on the last step.

props.name: labels
props.type: { back: string; next: string; finish: string }
props.description: Button text. Pass any subset to translate or rename.

props.name: allowClickNavigation
props.description: Let users click a completed step to go back to it.

items.title: Image Compare
items.description: Before and after slider. Drag the handle or use the arrow keys to reveal either side.

props.name: before
props.description: Bottom layer, shown on the left (or top). An image or any element.

props.name: after
props.description: Top layer, clipped by the handle and shown on the right (or bottom).

props.name: initial
props.description: Starting handle position from 0 to 100.

props.name: labels
props.description: Text of the corner chips. An empty string hides that chip.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of the split. Vertical moves the handle up and down.

items.usage: } after={} />

items.title: Masonry
items.description: Responsive column layout for mixed-height blocks, with a staggered entrance.

props.name: children
props.description: Items to lay out. Each child becomes one block.

props.name: columns
props.type: number | { base?: number; sm?: number; md?: number; lg?: number }
props.description: Column count, or a breakpoint map (sm 640px, md 768px, lg 1024px). Missing keys inherit the previous breakpoint.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between columns and between items, in pixels.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds between each item's entrance.

items.title: Animated List
items.description: Keyboard-friendly list with a staggered entrance, a sliding highlight and scroll fades.

props.name: items
props.description: Content of each row.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called on click or when Enter is pressed on the selected row.

props.name: initialSelected
props.description: Index selected on mount. -1 means none.

props.name: showGradients
props.description: Fade the top and bottom edges while the list can scroll.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height in pixels before the list scrolls.

items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: Bento layout of spanning cards with a cursor spotlight and a hover lift.

props.name: children
props.description: BentoCard elements (BentoGrid props).

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of grid columns (BentoGrid).

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between cards in pixels (BentoGrid).

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of one grid row in pixels (BentoGrid).

props.name: colSpan
props.description: Columns a card spans (BentoCard).

props.name: rowSpan
props.description: Rows a card spans (BentoCard).

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading (BentoCard).

props.name: description
props.description: Card supporting text (BentoCard).

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown above the title (BentoCard).

items.usage: <BentoGrid columns={3}><BentoCard colSpan={2} title="Fast" description="Zero config." /><BentoCard rowSpan={2} title="Tiny" /></BentoGrid>

props.name: children
props.description: Button label.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called once the hold completes.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds the button must be held.

props.name: color
props.description: Fill and focus ring color.

props.name: confirmedLabel
props.description: Label shown briefly after confirming.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignore presses and dim the button.

items.title: Spring Toggle
items.description: A switch whose knob squishes and overshoots when you flip it.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled state. Pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new state on every toggle.

props.name: size
props.description: Track and knob size.

props.name: color
props.description: Track color when on.

props.name: label
props.description: Text next to the switch. Clicking it toggles too.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Block interaction and dim the switch.

items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: iOS-style segmented control with a thumb that slides to the selected option.

props.name: options
props.type: { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }[]
props.description: The segments, in order.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selection. Pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selection when uncontrolled. Falls back to the first enabled option.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected value.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height and text size.

props.name: color
props.description: Thumb color. Pass your accent, e.g. #2f7bff, for a tinted thumb.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to the container with equal-width segments.

items.usage: <SegmentedControl aria-label="View" defaultValue="grid" options={[{ value: "grid", label: "Grid" }, { value: "list", label: "List" }]} />

items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A tooltip that trails the pointer with a soft lag, and settles in a fixed spot for keyboard focus.

props.name: content
props.description: What the tooltip shows.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger. Should be focusable, like a button or link.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which side of the pointer or trigger the tooltip sits on.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds before the tooltip appears.

props.name: follow
props.description: Trail the pointer while hovering. When off, the tooltip stays anchored to the trigger.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called whenever the value changes.

props.name: min
props.description: Lowest allowed value.

props.name: max
props.description: Highest allowed value.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment for arrow keys, and the grid values snap to while dragging.

props.name: sensitivity
props.description: Units changed per pixel dragged. Hold Shift for 10x.

props.name: label
props.description: Drag handle text, also the input's accessible name.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Unit shown after the number, such as px or %.

items.title: Flip Card

props.name: front
props.description: Content of the front face.

props.name: back
props.description: Content of the back face.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Flip on hover and focus, or toggle on click (renders a button with aria-pressed).

props.name: direction
props.description: Axis the card rotates around.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the flip.

props.description: App content that can call useToast().

props.name: position
props.description: Corner where toasts stack.

props.name: max

items.title: Lattice Loader
items.description: A compact loading indicator of dots or bars pulsing in a diagonal wave.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the whole loader in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Dot and bar color.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed multiplier.

props.name: shape
props.description: Layout of the loader.

props.name: columns
props.description: Dots per side for the grid shape (2 to 6).

props.name: label
props.description: Visually hidden text announced to screen readers.

items.title: Star Rating
items.description: Interactive star rating with hover preview, half steps and keyboard control.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the value changes.

props.name: max
props.description: Number of stars.

props.name: precision

props.name: size
props.description: Star size in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Fill color.

items.title: Features Section
items.description: A heading and a grid of feature cards with icon, title and description. Cards lift on hover and carry a soft cursor spotlight.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small pill label above the title. Pass an empty string to hide it.

props.name: title
props.description: Section heading.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Supporting text under the heading.

props.name: features
props.type: { icon?: ReactNode; title: string; description: string }[]

props.name: columns

props.name: layout
props.description: Grid of cards, or a single column of horizontal rows.

props.description: Accent color for the spotlight, icon tiles and eyebrow.

items.title: Testimonials Section
items.description: A heading and quote cards in a looping horizontal strip that pauses on hover. Falls back to a static grid.

props.name: title
props.description: Section heading.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Supporting text under the heading.

props.name: testimonials

props.name: title
props.description: Headline.

props.name: text
props.description: One line of supporting text.

props.name: primary
props.description: Filled accent pill button.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Outlined pill button.

props.name: accent
props.description: Glow and primary button color.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed multiplier.

props.description: Blob size. Bigger means larger, softer blobs.

props.description: Overall opacity of the canvas.

props.name: seed

props.description: Particle color.

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Color of the links between neighbors.

props.name: linkDistance
props.description: Max distance in pixels at which two particles are linked.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed multiplier.

props.name: size
props.description: Average particle radius in pixels.

props.name: seed
props.description: Same seed, same starting layout.

props.name: color
props.description: Ray color.

props.name: rays
props.description: Number of rays (1 to 64).

props.name: origin
props.description: Where the light comes from.

props.name: speed
props.description: Sway and pulse speed multiplier.

props.name: spread
props.description: Total angle covered by the rays, in degrees.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Brightness from 0 to 1.

props.name: seed
props.description: Same seed, same ray layout.

props.name: color
props.description: Beam color. Any CSS color; the core is lightened toward white.

props.name: count
props.description: How many beams.

props.name: speed

/>

items.title: Tabs Underline
items.description: Tabs with a measured sliding underline, icons, counts and crossfading panels.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Tabs with id, label, content and optional icon and count.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected tab id when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first tab.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected tab id.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes.

props.name: fitted
props.description: Stretch the tabs to share the full width.

props.name: color
props.description: Underline and focus ring color.

items.usage:
<TabsUnderline
  tabs={[
    { id: "overview", label: "Overview", content: "Project summary" },
    { id: "issues", label: "Issues", count: 12, content: "Open issues" },
  ]}
/>

items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: Columns of cards you can drag between lists and reorder, with a placeholder slot and add buttons.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns with id, title and cards. Each card has id, title and optional tag and tone (a CSS color for the tag dot).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new columns after a drop, a keyboard move or an added card.

props.name: newCardLabel
props.description: Title given to cards created with the add button.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent color for the drop slot and focus ring.

items.usage:
<KanbanBoard
  columns={[
    { id: "todo", title: "To do", cards: [{ id: "a", title: "Design review" }] },
    { id: "doing", title: "In progress", cards: [] },
    { id: "done", title: "Done", cards: [] },
  ]}
  onChange={(next) => console.log(next)}
/>

items.title: Streaming Text
items.description: Reveals an assistant reply word by word with a blinking cursor. Supports bold, inline code and line breaks. The server render shows the full text.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to reveal. Supports **bold**, `inline code` and newlines.

props.name: speed
props.description: Milliseconds per step.

props.name: chunk
props.description: Characters revealed per step. 0 reveals one word per step.

props.name: start
props.description: Begin streaming. While false the text stays empty after mount.

props.name: color
props.description: Cursor color.

props.name: cursor
props.description: Show the blinking cursor while streaming.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called once the last step is revealed.

items.usage: <StreamingText text="Deploy **482** is live. Run `relay logs` to follow it." />

items.title: Chat Thread
items.description: A scrolling conversation with user and assistant bubbles, avatars, timestamps, a streaming last reply, a typing indicator and auto-scroll to the newest message.

props.name: messages
props.type: { id: string; role: "user" | "assistant" | "system"; content: string; time?: string; streaming?: boolean }[]
props.description: Messages in order. Content supports **bold**, `inline code` and newlines. Set streaming on the last assistant message to reveal it progressively.

props.name: userName
props.description: Name used for the user avatar initials.

props.name: assistantName
props.description: Name used for the assistant avatar initials and typing label.

props.name: avatars
props.description: Custom avatar content. Defaults to initials.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height in pixels before the thread scrolls.

props.name: typing
props.description: Show the assistant typing indicator after the last message.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent color of user bubbles.

props.name: speed
props.description: Milliseconds per word for a streaming message.

items.usage: <ChatThread messages={[{ id: "1", role: "user", content: "Hello" }, { id: "2", role: "assistant", content: "Hi, how can I help?" }]} />

items.title: Tool Call Card
items.description: A collapsible card for a tool invocation with status, duration, syntax-colored arguments and result, and a copy button.

props.name: name
props.description: Tool name shown in the header.

props.name: status
props.description: Shows a spinner, a check or a cross.

props.name: duration
props.description: Elapsed time. Numbers are milliseconds and render as 420ms or 1.2s.

props.name: args
props.description: Arguments, rendered as JSON-like text. JSON strings are pretty-printed.

props.name: result
props.description: Result, rendered like args, with a copy button.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Start expanded.

props.name: color
props.description: Focus and running-state accent.

items.usage: <ToolCallCard name="search_docs" duration={420} args={{ query: "rollback" }} result={{ hits: 3 }} defaultOpen />

items.title: Thinking Indicator
items.description: A compact thinking state that cycles through phrases with a fade, as a shimmering label or breathing dots, with an optional elapsed timer.

props.name: phrases
props.description: Labels to cycle through.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds between phrases.

props.name: showTimer
props.description: Show elapsed time next to the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shimmering label, or breathing dots beside a plain label.

props.name: color
props.description: Dot color for the dots variant.

items.title: Prompt Bar
items.description: A chat composer with an auto-growing textarea, attach and mic buttons, a model picker and a send button. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.

props.name: models
props.description: Models offered in the picker.

props.name: defaultModel
props.description: Initially selected model. Defaults to the first entry.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Rows the textarea grows to before it scrolls.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder and accessible label of the textarea.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the whole composer.

props.name: color
props.description: Focus ring and send button color.

props.name: attachIcon
props.description: Replaces the default attach icon.

props.name: micIcon
props.description: Replaces the default mic icon.

props.name: onAttach
props.description: Called when the attach button is pressed.

props.name: onMic
props.description: Called when the mic button is pressed.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called with the trimmed text and the selected model. The field clears afterwards.

items.title: Agent Steps
items.description: A vertical plan or trace with pending, active, done and failed steps joined by a connector line that fills as steps complete.

props.name: steps
props.type: { id: string; title: string; detail?: string; status?: "pending" | "active" | "done" | "failed" }[]
props.description: Steps in order. A step status overrides activeIndex.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: Steps before it are done, it is active, the rest are pending.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent for the spinner, check and connector fill.

props.name: compact
props.description: Tighter spacing and smaller text.

items.usage: <AgentSteps activeIndex={1} steps={[{ id: "a", title: "Read config" }, { id: "b", title: "Run checks" }, { id: "c", title: "Ship" }]} />

items.title: Like Burst
items.description: A heart button that fills with a bouncy pop, scatters a ring of particles and rolls its count to the new value.

props.name: count
props.description: Total count at the initial liked state. Liking adds one to it, unliking takes it back.

props.name: liked
props.description: Controlled liked state. Pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultLiked
props.description: Initial liked state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called on every toggle with the new liked state and the new count.

props.name: color
props.description: Heart fill, ring and particle color.

props.name: size
props.description: Heart size in pixels. The button and count scale with it.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the toggle button.

items.title: Review Card
items.description: A customer review with avatar, half-star rating, a Read more clamp, a verified badge and a helpful vote.

props.name: rating
props.description: Rating from 0 to 5. Rounded to the nearest half star.

props.name: name
props.description: Reviewer name. Also seeds the initials avatar color.

props.name: date
props.description: Date text shown at the top right. Hidden when empty.

props.name: title
props.description: Short headline next to the stars.

props.name: text
props.description: Review body. Clamped to `lines` with a Read more toggle when it overflows.

props.name: verified
props.description: Show the Verified badge next to the name.

props.name: helpful
props.description: Starting helpful count. The vote button toggles one more on top.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Avatar image URL. Initials are shown when missing or when the image fails to load.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of text lines shown before the Read more toggle appears.

items.usage: <ReviewCard name="Maya J." rating={4.5} title="Worth it" text="Arrived early and healthy." verified helpful={12} />

items.title: Avatar Stack
items.description: Overlapping avatars with a +N tail. Hovering spreads them apart and shows a name tooltip.

props.name: people
props.type: { name: string; image?: string; color?: string }[]
props.description: People to show. Without an image the initials render on a color derived from the name, or on `color` when given.

props.name: size
props.description: Avatar diameter in pixels.

props.name: max
props.description: Most avatars to show. Anyone beyond it moves into the +N tail.

props.name: ring
props.description: Color of the ring around each avatar. Match it to the surface behind the stack.

props.name: extra
props.description: People you know about but did not list. Added to the +N tail.

items.usage: <AvatarStack people={[{ name: "Ada Lovelace" }, { name: "Alan Turing" }]} extra={12} />

items.title: Share Row
items.description: A row of share pills with monochrome glyphs that pick up each platform's accent on hover, a copy-link pill and a native share button.

props.name: links
props.description: Pills to render. Share URLs are built from title, url and text unless href is given. The copy pill briefly reads Copied.

props.name: title
props.description: Page title used for the post text, email subject and native share sheet.

props.name: url
props.description: URL to share. Falls back to the current page address when empty.

props.name: text
props.description: Extra message text for the post, email body and native share sheet.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Hide the pill labels and keep only the glyphs. Labels stay available to screen readers and as tooltips.

items.usage: <ShareRow title="Notes from the greenhouse" url={postUrl} links={[{ id: "x" }, { id: "email" }, { id: "copy" }]} />

items.title: Rating Summary
items.description: The average rating as a big number with stars and review total, beside five bars that fill in on mount.

props.name: counts
props.type: { 5: number; 4: number; 3: number; 2: number; 1: number } | number[]
props.description: Review counts per star level. An array is read from five stars down to one star.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the stars and bar fills.

props.name: showPercent
props.description: Show a percentage at the end of each bar. When false the raw count is shown.
